area-manager.la_posizione: To expand our sales team, we are looking for someone to develop the assigned markets, seek out new business opportunities and manage relationships with international customers and partners.

attivita: Business development and acquisition of new customers in the assigned markets.
Management and retention of existing customers.
Analysis of customer needs, together with the engineering department.
Preparation of commercial offers and management of negotiations.
Management of relationships with agents and sales partners.
Participation in trade fairs and customer visits.
Monitoring of sales opportunities and activities.
requisiti: Excellent written and spoken English, to handle meetings and negotiations independently.
Interpersonal, sales and negotiation skills.
Customer and goal orientation.
Willingness to travel internationally.
Organisational autonomy, proactivity and a team-working attitude.
requisiti_preferenziali: B2B sales experience in international markets.
Background in industrial machinery, automation or bottling & packaging.
Interest in and aptitude for understanding technical products.
cosa_offriamo: Product training directly in the workshop, where the machines are designed and built.
International travel to customers and trade fairs, in contact with producers from all over the world.

elettricista-plc.la_posizione: To expand our team, we are looking for a technician to join the electrical and automation department on a permanent contract.

attivita: Electrical wiring of industrial machinery.
Installation and testing of systems.
Programming and modification of PLC software.
Technical support and troubleshooting.
Machine start-up at customer sites.
requisiti: Experience in the industrial electrical sector.
Knowledge of Siemens, Omron, Mitsubishi or equivalent PLCs.
Ability to read wiring diagrams.
Willingness to travel occasionally.
Accuracy and a team-working attitude.
cosa_offriamo: Work on machinery designed and built in-house.
A place in a specialised technical team.

addetto-ufficio-tecnico.la_posizione: To strengthen our engineering department, we are looking for someone to join the mechanical design team, supporting production and the technical documentation of our machines.

attivita: 2D/3D mechanical drawing of machine components and assemblies.
Drafting and updating bills of materials (BOM) and construction drawings.
Technical support to production during machine assembly.
Working with the sales department on the technical configuration of offers.
Management of the drawing archive and technical product documentation.
requisiti: Diploma or degree in mechanical/mechatronic engineering.
Good knowledge of 2D/3D CAD software (SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor or equivalent).
Ability to read technical drawings and mechanical diagrams.
Accuracy, method and a team-working attitude.
requisiti_preferenziali: Previous experience in an engineering department working on automatic machines or industrial plants.
cosa_offriamo: Working directly alongside the engineering department and production, on the same machines designed and built in the company.
Continuous training on the product and design tools.

operaio-assemblaggio.la_posizione: Due to a temporary increase in production, we are looking for a skilled worker to join the assembly department, for the mechanical assembly of machines before testing.

attivita: Mechanical assembly of machine units and sub-units according to drawings.
Fitting of pneumatic, hydraulic and mechanical components.
Mechanical adjustments and dimensional checks during assembly.
Working with the electrical department on pre-test commissioning.
Reporting any non-conformities in the components received.
requisiti: Previous experience in assembling automatic or industrial machines.
Ability to read mechanical drawings.
Use of measuring instruments (calliper, dial gauge, etc.).
Accuracy, manual skills and a team-working attitude.
requisiti_preferenziali: Basic knowledge of pneumatics and hydraulics.
cosa_offriamo: Fixed-term contract, with the possibility of extension.
Work on machinery designed and built in-house.
Hands-on support in the assembly department.

customer-service.la_posizione: For our after-sales team, we are looking for someone to handle customer requests (spare parts, service, technical information), acting as the point of contact between customers and internal departments.

attivita: Handling incoming customer requests (email, phone, WhatsApp) about spare parts and service.
Routing technical requests to the service department or the engineering department.
Preparing spare parts quotations and tracking orders through to shipment.
Updating customer records and request history.
Supporting the planning of on-site and remote service interventions.
requisiti: Experience in customer service or sales back-office roles.
Good written and spoken English.
Accuracy, organisation and the ability to handle several requests at once.
Good familiarity with the main IT tools (email, management software, spreadsheets).
requisiti_preferenziali: Knowledge of a second foreign language.
Previous experience in industrial machinery or bottling & packaging.
Basic knowledge of an ERP system.
cosa_offriamo: Hybrid working, with the option of working remotely a few days a week.
Product training in direct contact with the engineering and service departments.
